LESSON: HAJJ AND UMRAH

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.2: Hajj and Umrah
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Hajj and Umrah, part of Devotional Acts in Grade 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: How is Hajj/Umrah performed? 2. Why do Muslims perform Hajj/ Umrah?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch video clips/read from available reference materials on the sequence of Hajj and make class presentations,

2. make a model of the Kaaba and demonstrate the performance of tawaf,

3. research on fardh, wajib and sunnah rites of Hajj and present on charts/PowerPoint,

4. discuss the rites of Umrah in groups and present in class,

5. research on the significance of Hajj and make notes. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch video clips/read from available reference materials on the sequence of Hajj and make class presentations,
2. make a model of the Kaaba and demonstrate the performance of tawaf,
3. research on fardh, wajib and sunnah rites of Hajj and present on charts/PowerPoint,
4. discuss the rites of Umrah in groups and present in class,
5. research on the significance of Hajj and make notes. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Hajj and Umrah together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: Self-awareness and planning skills enhanced as learners demonstrate the sequence of Hajj.

• Learning to Learn: the skill of carrying out research enhanced as learners research on fardh, wajib and sunnah

rites of Hajj and present on charts/PowerPoint.

• Communication and collaboration: the skills of listening and teamwork are enhanced as learners discuss the rites of

Umrah in groups and present in class.
